## Summary

Describe the change, its purpose, and related issues. Do not include private vulnerability details.

## Verification

Describe the checks performed and their results. Explain any checks that are not applicable.

- [ ] Changes are focused, with no unrelated modifications.
- [ ] Applicable tests pass, and regression coverage is included for behavior changes.
- [ ] Applicable pre-commit linting and formatting checks pass.
- [ ] The proposed history is linear, or the change will be squash- or rebase-merged to preserve linear history.
- [ ] Automated secret scanning passes; no credentials, tokens, or sensitive client data are included.
- [ ] Markdown and metadata contain no personal names, personal telephone numbers, or residential addresses.
- [ ] Public content is vendor-neutral and contains no government certification numbers, micro-business labels, or procurement tags.
- [ ] All commercial and inbound contact links use contact@mogsec.com or https://mogsec.com.
- [ ] Security impact has been reviewed; suspected vulnerabilities are reported privately to contact@mogsec.com.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.

## Risk & Rollback

Describe operational impact and how to revert the change. State when not applicable.
